title: Test first: data categories and the owner's allow or deny per category
goal: Categories: owner question, tool results (untainted), tool results (tainted, Ireul), memory facts, memory summaries, Grover data; each allow or deny, default deny except the owner question
acceptance: Failing tests first on the filter that builds the cloud request: a denied category is removed or the call is refused if the plan cannot be made without it
Tainted tool results never go to the cloud unless the owner allows that category by name; Casper and its inspected arguments never go to the cloud, whatever the setting
`nerv models cloud allow|deny <category>` and a settings panel list; a test across config, filter and the Consultant and Misato calls
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no keys, tokens, personal data or real Grover readings in Git.
escalation: Any run of a real model or a cloud call needs the owner's yes first
A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27 from the code paths read for this plan. Not a measurement.
